note.name: Pepe
note.thesis: No protocol revenue and no dated catalyst leave PEPE a pure sentiment trade. Price sits at its 30-day and 90-day high, longs are crowded and top wallets are concentrated, so the evidence favours the lower half of the eight-week range.
note.what: PEPE is an Ethereum ERC-20 meme token launched 14 April 2023 with a fixed supply, no tax, no staking and no governance. Holders send and trade it; liquidity providers earn DEX swap fees, and traders use it as high-beta meme exposure. It pays holders nothing.

points.text: There is no PEPE protocol fee, so no fee series exists to annualise and no revenue reaches holders. The project white paper identifies no project revenues.
CoinGecko reads circulating, total and maximum supply all 420,690B. TokenRadar shows 97.01% released with no dated next unlock; none is scheduled in 90 days.
Top 10 wallets hold 34.7% and top 50 hold 64.4% of supply. Binance's hot wallet alone holds 11.7%, with exchange omnibus wallets large.
Funding is +0.0100%/8h and the seven-day average is +0.0101%/8h. Open interest is $111M, up 21.8% in seven days, and 72% of accounts are long.
Spot is +19.3% over 30 days and at its 30-day and 90-day high. The 7.77T attacker dump has been absorbed and the Canary ETF filing is live optionality.

note.supplyText: CoinGecko shows circulating, total and maximum supply all at 420,690B. TokenRadar has 97.01% released with no final release date, while Tokenomist says 100% unlocked; the gap is a modelled reserve. No unlock is scheduled in the next 90 days. Top 10 wallets hold 34.7%.
note.valuationHeadline: No cash flow, so no multiple
note.valuationText: PEPE has no protocol fee and no identified revenue, so FDV ÷ annualised fees and FDV ÷ annualised revenue do not apply. CoinGecko puts FDV at $2.13B. Verified FDV and revenue for DOGE, SHIB and BONK were not available, so no peer median is quoted.
note.usageText: There is no PEPE protocol fee, staking reward, points programme or native emission. Activity is speculative spot and derivatives trading. DEX and liquidity-provider fees go to the pools, not to holders. No protocol revenue has been identified.

risks.title: ETF approval
risks.text: The SEC clears the Canary Capital S-1/A, adding the dated demand catalyst the no-catalyst case does not assume.

risks.title: Attacker supply absorbed
risks.text: Spot held through the 7.77T dump; further absorption of known sellers would weaken the supply-overhang case.

risks.title: Funding stays mild
risks.text: Funding of +0.0100%/8h is positive but not extreme, so a leverage flush may not follow.

risks.title: Concentration proves benign
risks.text: Large exchange wallets and top holders are omnibus custody rather than sellers, so concentration does not translate into distribution.

watchlist.item: Canary Capital PEPE ETF S-1/A under SEC review, no fixed deadline
Unlock status: TokenRadar 97.01% released vs Tokenomist 100%
2.27T PEPE moved from dormant wallets, no confirmed follow-through
Justin Sun described as top whale; the $52M figure

note.positioningText: Funding is positive at +0.0100%/8h and has averaged +0.0101%/8h over seven days: longs pay shorts, but the rate is not extreme. Open interest of $111M is up 21.8% in a week and 72% of accounts are long.
note.conclusion: PEPE offers no cash flow and no dated catalyst. Spot sits at its 30-day and 90-day high while longs are crowded and top-10 wallets hold 34.7% of supply. The eight-week 1σ range is $0.00000345 to $0.00000751, and the evidence points to the lower half of it.
note.invalidation: SEC approval of the Canary Capital PEPE ETF S-1/A
note.gaps: No protocol fee or revenue series exists for 30, 90 or 12 months. Verified peer FDV and revenue for DOGE, SHIB and BONK were unavailable, so no peer median is quoted. Unlock trackers disagree, and nothing shows whether the 2.27T dormant move was sold.
